##### Project general facts

Nasim Al Bahr Residences is a refined coastal development that captures the essence of modern seaside living through a seamless connection between architecture and nature. Designed as a dialogue between sea, sand, and sky, its sculpted twin towers reflect the natural rhythm of the Gulf, combining flowing lines, expansive glass façades, and elegant stone detailing. The result is a serene and sophisticated environment where the changing light of sunrise and sunset becomes an integral part of everyday life.

The project offers a collection of residences, villas, and penthouses, each thoughtfully designed to maximize space, light, and natural surroundings. Interiors feature a harmonious palette of natural stone, warm timber tones, and subtle metallic accents, creating a calm and elegant atmosphere inspired by coastal landscapes. Open-plan living areas, fully equipped kitchens, and high-quality finishes ensure both comfort and functionality, transforming daily living into a refined and tranquil experience.

Nasim Al Bahr Residences is complemented by a curated selection of lifestyle and wellness amenities designed to elevate the residential experience. Residents have access to fine dining venues, lounges, a spa, indoor padel courts, and a private pool, alongside fitness facilities, children’s areas, and entertainment spaces such as games and screening rooms. Enhanced by concierge services and hospitality expertise, the development creates a seamless blend of privacy, leisure, and elevated coastal living.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.o.
